Paired-samples comparison of composite linguistic distancing, reappraise negative versus look negative. This comparison prints d = 0.72 and t(106) = 7.71, p < .001. Preserve printed d rather than convert to requested partial eta-squared. The nearby partial eta-squared .25 accompanies F(2, 212) = 35.97 for differences across all three conditions and is not the specified pairwise comparison.
